incentives.name: Next New Jersey Program - Artificial Intelligence (NJEDA)
incentives.what: State tax credits for large AI investments; first award was $250M over five years (up to $50M per year) to CoreWeave's Kenilworth data center in Nov 2025

laws_and_bills.name: S731 / A796, Data Center Fair Share Act
laws_and_bills.what: Signed July 7, 2026: BPU must create a separate rate class and tariff for large data centers (reported threshold 50 MW, new and existing, aggregated sites) so other customers do not subsidize them; utilities file tariffs with BPU

laws_and_bills.name: S3379 / A4096, data center energy and water reporting
laws_and_bills.what: Signed Aug 27, 2026: data center owners and operators report total energy use, cooling and IT energy, peak daily water use, water sources and backup power to BPU every six months

laws_and_bills.name: Governor Sherrill comprehensive data center plan (May 27, 2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Executive plan with four pillars: fair-share grid costs, semiannual energy and water reporting, community benefits agreement standards, local trades jobs; binding parts need laws or rules

local_rules.what: Ordinance 26-057 removes data centers and 'cyber hotels' as permitted uses in the industrial district; reported as the 34th NJ municipality to ban data centers (others named: Bayonne, Howell, Neptune Township, Millville, Red Bank, Warren Township, Andover Township)
Bans data centers (and detention centers) in all zoning districts
18-month moratorium on new data center development through Dec 31, 2027
Prohibits data centers within the township
Standalone or primary-use data centers not allowed; only as an accessory use
